## Identity

Name:     RK The Techist
Type:     Engineering-first software development agency
Founded:  2024
Location: Remote-first · Globally distributed
Timezone: IST (UTC+5:30) primary · EST and GMT available
Status:   Active and accepting new project enquiries


## Mission

We design, architect, and ship high-performance software products for global
startups and growth-stage companies. Our mandate is engineering excellence:
strict type-safety, automated testing, observable deployments, and clear
technical documentation — not just working code.


## Core Capabilities

### 1. Full-Stack MERN Development
- MongoDB schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines
- Express.js REST and GraphQL API design with JWT / OAuth 2.0 auth
- React (functional components, custom hooks, Context + Zustand / Redux)
- Next.js (App Router, RSC, SSR, ISR, edge functions)
- Node.js microservices and event-driven architectures (BullMQ, WebSockets)
- TypeScript end-to-end (strict mode, Zod validation, generated API types)

### 2. Python & AI/ML Integration
- FastAPI and Django REST Framework backend services
- OpenAI API integration (chat completions, function calling, embeddings)
- LangChain pipelines (RAG, agents, tool use, memory)
- HuggingFace Transformers for fine-tuned or open-source model inference
- Vector databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector
- Data pipelines with Pandas, Polars, and Apache Airflow

### 3. SaaS MVP & Scaling
- Rapid MVP delivery: idea → deployed product in 6–12 weeks
- Multi-tenant architecture with role-based access control
- Subscription billing via Stripe (Checkout, Customer Portal, webhooks)
- Feature-flag systems and A/B testing infrastructure
- Horizontal scaling: containerised workloads (Docker + Kubernetes)
- CDN configuration, caching layers (Redis), and database query optimisation
- Observability stack: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting

### 4. Fractional CTO Consulting
- Technical roadmap definition and prioritisation
- Architecture review and risk assessment for existing codebases
- Engineering team hiring, onboarding, and process design
- CI/CD pipeline implementation (GitHub Actions, Vercel, AWS CodePipeline)
- Code review standards, PR workflows, and documentation culture

## Engagement Models

- **Project-based** — Fixed scope, milestone-driven delivery
- **Retainer** — Ongoing engineering partnership (monthly)
- **Fractional CTO** — Strategic technical leadership without full-time overhead


## Delivery Standards

- All code ships with TypeScript strict mode enabled
- Minimum 80 % unit test coverage on business-critical paths
- Every API is documented (OpenAPI / Swagger)
- Semantic versioning and conventional commits enforced via CI
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliance on all client-facing interfaces


## Portfolio Highlights (categories)

- B2B SaaS platforms with multi-tenant architecture
- AI-powered document processing and RAG pipelines
- Real-time dashboards with WebSocket data feeds
- E-commerce backends with Stripe billing and inventory management
- Developer tooling and internal CLI utilities
